name: Sandy Springs Campground
note: Campground on the Ohio River bank near Stout (Adams Co); every site full hookup (water, sewer, electric), plus cabin and camper rentals, store, boat ramp. October 2026 rates: basic $45, riverview $50, riverside $65 per night. Google 4.9 over 206 reviews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: sandyspringscampground.com booking pages (read by AWH 2026-10-01; site sits behind an 'I am human' check): every site has electricity, sewer and water; October 2026 nightly basic $45 / riverview $50 / riverside $65, quoted for 1 night -> real transient RV campground; published base $45 (2026) <= $50; quality: Google 4.9 over 206 reviews

name: Fireside Lake Campground
note: Large lake campground near East Rochester (Columbiana Co), new owners since 2023; mostly seasonal, but ~150 weekend/short-term sites (O/P/WS blocks, Hilltop, R row) away from the shore - the lakeside sites are all seasonal. October 2026 rates: economy W/E 20/30A $50, standard $55, preferred $60, full hookup $65. Swimming, jumping pillow, store; day passes for visitors. Google 4.6 over 134 reviews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Staylist booking (read by AWH 2026-10-01): October 2026 nightly economy $50 (20/30A electric + water), standard $55, preferred $60, full hookup $65 -> published base $50 (2026) <= $50; operator site map (FiresideMapColor 2025) marks ~150 weekend/short-term sites distinct from the seasonal ones -> a real transient block, not seasonal-only; quality: Google 4.6 over 134 reviews

name: Zion Retreat & RV Park
note: Year-round RV park on 1,300 acres of hills and ponds above Flushing (Belmont Co): large treed full-hookup sites, big-rig friendly, around a 27-acre lake with swimming, paddle craft, zip line, hiking and mountain-bike trails; cabins too. October 2026 back-in full hookup $50/night, no minimum stay. RV campground bookings are non-refundable. Google 4.5 over 122 reviews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: zionretreatrvpark.com + ResNexus booking (read by AWH 2026-10-01): October 2026 back-in full hookup $50/night, no minimum stay -> real transient RV park; published base $50 (2026) <= $50; quality: Google 4.5 over 122 reviews

name: Lake Wapusun RV Resort
note: Large wooded campground in Amish country between Wooster and Loudonville (Shreve), around a 23-acre swimming/fishing lake and five smaller ones; mostly seasonal, but ~85 standard back-in RV sites (30A and 20A) are sold nightly, in the west block away from the lake - the lakeside sites are all seasonal. 2026 rates: 20A back-in $38.21, 30A back-in $49.32. Open Apr 3-Oct 25 (2026). Jumping pillow, kayak/paddleboat rentals, dog park. Google 4.2 over 335 reviews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Campspot booking (read by AWH 2026-10-01): standard back-in 30A $49.32, 20A $38.21 -> published base $38.21 (2026) <= $50; operator site map (LakeWapusunMap.pdf) marks 'Standard Back-In RV Site (30-amp/20-amp)' distinct from the seasonal types -> real transient block, not seasonal-only; visitor passes apply only to day guests; quality: Google 4.2 over 335 reviews

name: Kool Lakes Family RV Park
note: Large family campground near Garrettsville (Portage Co) with three spring-fed lakes - a 1.5-acre swimming lake with sandy beach and two fishing lakes; mostly seasonal, but water/electric and full-hookup pull-through sites are sold nightly (2026: W/E $60, W/E/S $65 for a family of four; one-night deposit, 2-night deposit on holiday weekends). Season May 1-Oct 15. Free swimming and fishing for campers. RV Life 4*/$$ ~$33/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.2 over 260 reviews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: koollakes.com/campsites-garrettsville-oh (read 2026-10-01): 2026 daily W/E $60, W/E/S $65, one-night deposit for campsites (the 2-night minimum is cabins only) -> real transient RV campground beside a large seasonal section; price gate passes on RV Life $$ (AWH 2026-10-01 gate, no price check); quality RV Life 4* over 21 reviews, Google 4.2 over 260
